tasks.short: Sell tickets and items through the till

steps.what: Clarify the customer's ticket or item request
Enter the selected tickets or items in the till
Check final sale, ticket details and payment amount
Receive payment and return any change
Commit the paid sale in the till
Issue the purchased ticket or item and receipt

tasks.design: Configure common ticket and item quick keys in the point-of-sale system {OTHER}. Keep customer clarification, scanning, sale checks, payment, the actual transaction commitment and physical ticket/item issue fully counted apart from a small reduction in repeated menu navigation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Common unbarcoded ticket codes require repeated menu navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native till quick keys may reduce those selections without changing the sale process.
tasks.still_hard: Wrong dates, quantities, concessions and payment exceptions need attention.
tasks.human_edge: The cashier checks that the customer receives the intended valid purchase.
tasks.altitude: Cashier responsibility and customer contact stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native point-of-sale quick keys can shorten repeated unbarcoded item selection; existing totals and sale recording already run automatically and earn no new saving.

assumptions: Boundary is a staffed till sale of tickets or other items through physical delivery. No self-checkout or transferred customer labour is assumed. The stated small menu saving applies only where common tickets currently lack direct keys.

Catalogue owners already supply item/ticket identifier, valid date/category, price, concession conditions and stock/availability. s1-s2 capture customer choices and quantities and manually resolve missing catalogue entries. s3 checks the complete sale and prospective ticket/receipt payload.

Test native keys first. Only 1.75 points of s2 menu navigation disappear; scanning, original entry, selection checking, exception correction and ordinary draft saving remain in 33.25 points. No gain is claimed for totals, payment-terminal runtime or the one-point sale commit.

s3 binds the exact sale, customer, ticket details, amount and payment method before payment, actual sale commitment and issue. Any change returns to s3; payment failure blocks s5/s6. These are real commercial actions, not a self-gate on an ordinary author save. All action time stays fully retained.
Shares and upkeep are provisional model estimates.
unknowns: Whether common tickets already have quick keys
research_questions: Time menu navigation separately from scanning and customer clarification
Can native keys preserve ticket validity and concession checks?

already_counted.description: Original till entry, missing-item repair and complete sale checks.

incremental.description: Maintain common ticket keys after catalogue changes.

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact final sale, amount, payment method and customer; changes void approval
s3 exact final commercial transaction; successful matching payment required, changes void approval
s3 exact ticket/item and receipt payload for this customer; matching paid sale required, changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes 1.75 navigation points less 0.5 upkeep. Conservative uncommon ticket mix has few reusable keys, removing only 0.7 navigation point and leaving manual selection intact: 0.2 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Pack merchandise and prepare its shipment label

steps.what: Verify shipment address, service and merchandise details
Bag, box, wrap or gift-wrap the merchandise securely
Prepare the parcel address and carrier label draft
Check final label, parcel, service and recipient
Book the checked parcel service and print its label
Attach the printed carrier label to the checked parcel

tasks.design: For the shipment-preparation branch, configure native reuse of checked sale/address fields in the shipping module of {OTHER}. Physical wrapping and parcel measurement remain intact; the cashier checks the completed carrier payload before the separately gated service booking and label print.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing address details are repeated in the parcel label form.
tasks.enabler_now: A native shipping form may reuse selected transaction fields.
tasks.still_hard: Fragility, package fit and address ambiguity need personal checking.
tasks.human_edge: The cashier packs goods appropriately and notices a mismatched parcel or destination.
tasks.altitude: Packaging work and shipment responsibility stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native shipping forms can reuse checked address fields while actual packaging and final label checks remain manual.

assumptions: This graph covers merchandise that is actually prepared for shipment with an existing carrier label workflow. An ordinary carry-away bag or gift-wrap task has no address/label baseline and needs different weights. Physical carrier collection is later work, not silently automated here.

s1 includes original capture and verification of recipient name/address, service selection and sale identifier from the customer and sale record. s2 includes measuring weight and dimensions. s3 retains original parcel-field entry, address corrections and manual fallback. No new structured address or scale feed is assumed free.

Test native sale-to-label field reuse first. Three points of repeated name/address typing disappear from s3; 12 points remain for entry, checking and repair. s4 retains complete address, service and parcel validation plus label repair. More repair lowers the estimate; ordinary draft saves have no gate or saving.

s5 is the actual carrier service commitment, not a same-system save. Its one point remains fully retained. Exact parcel, service, charge and address are checked at s4; any edit voids approval. s6 attaches the label only after s5 prints it; all five points of physical attachment time remain retained.
Shares and upkeep are provisional model estimates; confirm actual interaction and physical label placement order before rollout.
unknowns: Share of shipment versus carry-away wrapping tasks
research_questions: Can checked address fields be reused without new customer-data capture?
Observe actual label preparation separately from physical wrapping

already_counted.description: Original shipment capture, parcel entry, full label checking and manual repair.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final parcel service, label payload, charge and recipient address; any edit voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes three repeated-address points less 0.5 upkeep. Conservative handwritten-address/customer-correction case leaves only 0.8 point of reusable existing fields, giving 0.3 net. All packaging and booking time remains retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Check and cash an eligible customer cheque

steps.what: Find the applicable cheque-cashing policy and issuer conditions
Examine the cheque and verify the customer's identity
Resolve issuer verification and cheque exceptions
Decide eligibility and check the final cash payout
Cash checks for customers by disbursing the approved amount
Record the actual cheque payout in the till

tasks.design: For an organisation that actually offers cheque cashing, configure a native current-policy link in {DOCS}. Retain identity checks, issuer contact, payout judgement, physical cash handling and the existing point-of-sale record in {OTHER}; no bank verification API or automatic payout is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding issuer-specific policy requires repeated document navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native policy links can remove a small lookup interaction.
tasks.still_hard: Authenticity, eligibility and fraud concerns need authorised staff judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The cashier recognises an inconsistent instrument or customer explanation.
tasks.altitude: Payout authority and checks stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: cheque-cashing policy retrieval can use native document links; cheque cashing is not assumed to be a common service in every European retailer.

assumptions: Boundary is a permitted cheque-cashing service that actually exists today, including its original payout record. Confirm jurisdiction, service availability and delegated authority; if absent, the task is not a local baseline.

Policy owners supply policy identifier, effective date, issuer conditions and limits. The customer supplies the instrument and identification; s2-s4 retain all required verification, capture and manual exception work. No machine infers fraud or assumes access to bank balances.

Try native policy links first. Only 1.5 points of s1 navigation disappear; 13.5 points of reading, checking and manual lookup remain. s4 approves the exact amount, instrument and recipient after verification. Any change voids s5's approval.

s6 is an actual ordinary internal payout record used for cash reconciliation. Its one point, including saving, is fully retained and ungated; no self-approval or save saving. Shares are provisional model estimates.
research_questions: Can a current-policy link shorten lookup without hiding issuer exceptions?

already_counted.description: Read policy, trace missing conditions and retain original payout recording.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final payout amount, instrument and identified customer; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes 1.5 policy-navigation points less 0.4 upkeep. Conservative unfamiliar issuer requires manual condition tracing and removes only 0.6 navigation point, leaving 0.2 net. Cash and original recording retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Offer carry-out service after a sale

steps.what: Assess the purchased packages and immediate carry-out needs
Offer the customer carry-out service and clarify their preference

tasks.design: Keep the carry-out offer as a brief personal interaction after the completed sale. A native till reminder in {OTHER} may remind staff, but does not remove the customer's conversation or assessment and is not counted as a time saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: The service offer depends on noticing and asking the customer.
tasks.enabler_now: No labour-removing change to this brief offer is established.
tasks.still_hard: The customer may prefer privacy or a particular kind of assistance.
tasks.human_edge: The cashier offers help respectfully and understands the response.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in this offer boundary.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: offering carry-out assistance is a short personal service interaction; a reminder alone does not remove it.

assumptions: Boundary is the stated offer at completion of a transaction, not the preceding sale or the later physical carrying service. No required carry-out record is established. Actual helper dispatch, booking entry or message, where part of today's offer process, must be added and timed separately before a wider estimate.
s1 uses actual purchased packages and direct observation; s2 obtains the customer's preference. No structured input, new record or automatic dispatch is required.

Before choosing zero, inspect till reminders, lookup, request entry and sends separately from conversation. A reminder may improve consistency but does not shorten this offer, and a trailing service log nobody uses must not be invented.
No new system or capture is introduced; incremental upkeep is zero. Shares are model estimates and include only the cashier's effort.
unknowns: Whether actual accepted offers trigger a separate helper dispatch or required entry
research_questions: Observe an accepted carry-out offer and time any real helper dispatch separately

incremental.description: No new technology, record or maintenance is introduced for the offer.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The assessed package context and spoken offer remain fully retained. No existing lookup, record or send with removable time is established in this offer-only boundary.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: A cashier retaining customer contact, payments, package handling and transaction checks, with small specific reductions in menu and address re-entry.
skills_to_grow: Validate till quick keys and ticket conditions
Check parcel labels against original addresses
Distinguish a commercial commitment from an ordinary record save
role.ambitious_version: Keep service and money handling personal while reducing demonstrated repeated screen interactions.
